question: Can broader diversification use more of the shared cash after an individual position is limited by tradable volume?
single_variable: Allow eighteen distinct concurrent positions with a normal collateral budget per parent equal to NAV/18, compared to the preregistered nine-slot NAV/9 portfolio. Keep the original low-prior-ATR selection, last completed H1 average-minute volume ceiling at 10%, actual 1x/2x side tilt, four actual children, 2R order, long doubling order, 20% hourly trim and all dates and fees. Do not take multiple positions in the same symbol. No increase in aggregate cash budget.
benchmark: Original-ATR arm of exp-cloud-close-liquid-queue-20261109-v1 (same opportunity history, prices, funding omissions and conservative ordering). Run extra 5bp market slippage.
